definitions.short: Elon , the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites
definitions.full: H356. Elon II. אֵלוֺן proper name, masculine (= id. compare אֵלָה proper name ) 1 a son of Zebulun Gen 46:14 ; Num 26:26 . 2 אֵילֹן Gen 26:34 ; אֵיִלוֺן 36:2 a Hittite, father-in-law of Esau. 3 אֵילוֺן Judg 12:11-12 , a judge of Israel, of tribe of Zebulun 4. proper name, of a location אֵילוֺן Josh 19:43 a town of Dan; so 1Kin 4:9 (where read ׳א ח ׳וּבֵית Th Klo).
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) אֵלוֹן ; or אֵילֹן ; from 352 ; oak-grove;

occurrences.englishText: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
